大陆网络推荐，下载快。: Recommended on mainland China networks; fast.
海外网络直连；大陆网络可能很慢或失败。: Direct from outside mainland China; may be slow or fail on mainland networks.
下载 Windows 安装包，安装时勾选「Add python.exe to P: Download the Windows installer, tick "Add python.exe to PATH" during setup, then press Check again.
下载 macOS 安装包并安装，装好后点「重新检测」。: Download and run the macOS installer, then press Check again.
建议用系统包管理器安装：sudo apt install python3 pyt: Install it with your package manager: sudo apt install python3 python3-venv python3-pip (use the equivalent on other distributions), then press Check again.

约 {0}，通常 {1}–{2} 分钟（估算，取决于网速）: About {0}, usually {1}–{2} minutes (an estimate; depends on your connection)
先安装 Python（推荐 {0}），再回来点「一键安装 Marker」。从下面: Install Python first (version {0} recommended), then come back and press One-click install Marker. Download it from any of these:
无法打开文件夹选择器，请直接输入路径。: The folder picker could not be opened; type the path instead.
安装位置的完整路径: Full path of the install location
例如 D:\\Tools\\marker 或 /home/me/marker；文: For example D:\Tools\marker or /home/me/marker; a folder that does not exist is created.
这个文件夹里已经有别的文件，会装进里面新建的「StudyHub-Marker」文: This folder already has other files, so Marker goes into a new StudyHub-Marker folder inside it; the existing files are not touched.
只在上面的安装位置里创建环境，不修改系统的 Python，也不需要管理员权限。: The environment is created only in the location above. The system Python is not changed and no administrator rights are needed.
安装到这个位置并删除旧环境: Install here and delete the old environment
新环境装好并通过检测后，才会删除旧的那个；失败时旧的保持可用。: The old environment is deleted only after the new one is installed and passes the check; if it fails, the old one stays usable.
只在你点击后才会安装；marker-pdf 用 pip 下载，需要联网。: Nothing is installed until you press the button; marker-pdf is downloaded with pip, which needs a network connection.
下载没有精确的百分比；只要上面这一行在变化，就是在进行。请不要关闭 StudyH: Downloads have no exact percentage; as long as the line above keeps changing, it is working. Please do not close StudyHub.
之前装好的 Marker 仍然可用。: The Marker installed earlier is still usable.
Marker 已安装，但检测没有通过: Marker is installed, but the check did not pass
已安装到 {0}，程序路径已自动填好。: Installed in {0}; the program path is filled in for you.
已安装到 {0}，但检测没有通过。点下面的「检测并保存」再试，或重新安装。: Installed in {0}, but the check did not pass. Press Check and save below to try again, or reinstall.
第一次解析时会下载 Marker 的模型，需要联网和几分钟，之后就不用了。: The first conversion downloads Marker's models, which needs a network connection and a few minutes; after that it does not.
将删除 StudyHub 为 Marker 创建的环境（{0}）。这个文件夹里不: This deletes the environment StudyHub created for Marker ({0}). Files in that folder that it did not create are left alone. Sources already converted are not affected.
让 StudyHub 另外安装一份 Marker: Let StudyHub install a separate copy of Marker
换用「国内直连」的下载源，或检查网络和代理后，点「重试」。: Switch to a download source marked Reachable in mainland China, or check the network and proxy, then press Retry.
清理磁盘，或点「更改位置」换到空间更大的磁盘后重试。: Free some disk space, or press Change location to use a disk with more room, then retry.
点「更改位置」换一个你有写入权限的文件夹后重试。: Press Change location and pick a folder you can write to, then retry.
把安装位置里 venv 的 marker_single 路径填到下面的输入框，点: Type the path of marker_single inside the venv folder of the install location into the box below, then press Check and save.
没有改动任何设置。需要时点「重试」。: No settings were changed. Press Retry when you want to.
点「重试」接着安装，已下载的内容会被 pip 缓存复用。: Press Retry to continue; what was already downloaded is reused from pip's cache.
展开「技术详情」查看原始日志，修正后点「重试」。: Open Technical details to read the raw log, fix the cause, then press Retry.
已经有 Marker？手动指定程序路径: Already have Marker? Set the program path yourself
没有找到 Python。请先安装 Python 3.10 或更新版本，装好后再点: Python was not found. Install Python 3.10 or newer first, then press One-click install Marker.
找到的 Python 版本太旧（Marker 需要 3.10 或更新版本）。请安: The Python found is too old (Marker needs 3.10 or newer). Install a newer Python and retry.
这个 Python 缺少创建虚拟环境的组件（venv / ensurepip）。: This Python lacks the parts that create virtual environments (venv / ensurepip). On Linux, install python3-venv and python3-pip, then retry.
安装位置所在磁盘的剩余空间不够。请换一个位置，或清理磁盘后重试。: The disk of the install location does not have enough free space. Choose another location, or free some space and retry.
这个安装位置不能用。请选择一个已存在或可以新建的文件夹的完整路径。: This install location cannot be used. Give the full path of a folder that exists or can be created.
这个位置里已经有别的文件，StudyHub 不会往里面安装。请选一个空文件夹，或: This location already holds other files and StudyHub will not install into it. Choose an empty folder, or let it create StudyHub-Marker inside.
这个位置没有写入权限，请换一个位置。: You cannot write to this location. Choose another one.
没有这个下载源。: There is no such download source.
Marker 正在安装，请等它完成或先取消。: Marker is being installed. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it first.
安装 Marker 会下载并占用磁盘空间，需要先确认：请传 confirm: t: Installing Marker downloads files and uses disk space, so it needs confirmation first: pass confirm: true.
卸载前需要先确认：请传 confirm: true。只会删除 StudyHub: Uninstalling needs confirmation first: pass confirm: true. Only the environment StudyHub created is deleted.
这个文件夹不是 StudyHub 创建的 Marker 环境，不会删除其中任何内: This folder is not a Marker environment created by StudyHub, so nothing in it is deleted.
Marker 正在安装，请先取消再卸载。: Marker is being installed. Cancel it before uninstalling.
没能创建 Python 虚拟环境。: The Python virtual environment could not be created.
下载 marker-pdf 失败，多半是网络不通。: Downloading marker-pdf failed, most likely because the network is not reachable.
磁盘空间不足，安装中断。: The disk ran out of space and the install stopped.
没有权限写入安装位置。: No permission to write to the install location.
这个 Python 版本装不上 marker-pdf。: marker-pdf cannot be installed with this Python version.
安装结束了，但没有找到 marker_single 程序。: The install finished, but the marker_single program was not found.
装好的 Marker 没能通过检测（版本可能与 StudyHub 不兼容）。: The installed Marker did not pass the check (the version may not be compatible with StudyHub).
装好了，但没能把程序路径写进设置。: It is installed, but the program path could not be saved in the settings.
上次安装被中断（StudyHub 关闭或重启）。: The last install was interrupted (StudyHub was closed or restarted).
启动 Docker Desktop，等它显示正在运行，再点「重新检测」；失败的转: Start Docker Desktop, wait until it says it is running, then press Check again; a conversion that failed goes on with Continue.
在同一个位置重新安装 1.x：模型直接在 Marker 里运行，不需要 Dock: Install 1.x again in the same place: the models run inside Marker, with no Docker. Pages already converted are not affected.
这份 Marker 不是 StudyHub 装的：用下面的「一键安装 Marke: StudyHub did not install this Marker: install a 1.x with One-click install below, or run pip install "marker-pdf>=1.10,<2" in its own Python environment, then press Check and save.
